item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. It will unlock new industries, expand human ambition, and generate work we cannot yet imagine.

2. We reject the idea that technological progress inevitably means fewer jobs. Superintelligent AI will increase productivity, create new forms of work, and give people the tools to solve bigger problems.

3. Superintelligent AI will transform the labor market—and expand it. We must prepare people to lead that transformation through education, training, and strong worker transitions.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 110 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. It will expand human ambition, unlock new industries, and turn once-impossible ideas into everyday work. As productivity rises, demand will grow for people who build, guide, apply, and improve these systems—and for the countless roles created by the prosperity they generate. We should prepare boldly: modernize education, strengthen worker transitions, and ensure the gains reach every community. Fear of change must not become a veto on progress. Our task is to shape this transformation so people can seize its opportunities and build a richer, more capable future together.
